body:
First off, a little history on me. I'm a 24 year old male, married, no kids. I've experimented with many drugs including, marijuana, shrooms, X, acid, meth, coke and a whole variety of prescription pills. I started my experimentation w/ drugs at the age of 16 and was a heavy (almost every day) of meth, X, coke, and loritab for about 2 years (about 5 years total use). I feel the toll drugs have taken on my brain over the years mainly memory loss. I fortunately found my way out of the cloud about 2 years ago with the help of a scare from sleep deprivation and paranoia from 5 straight days of meth. I can't do many drugs these days because my job of an electronic technician doesn't mix well with foggy brains, So this prompted me to search for legal alternatives. I began my search always keeping in mind my old and favorite friend XTC. Eventually after a short search, I found the substance known as  'BK MDMA'. The first thing I noticed was the name and how similar it's effects are to MDMA. So after reading a few experiences on reputable websites, I decided I wanted to give it a try. That was an excellent move on my part!
I received the methylone in the mail and decided to test it's effects before I used it at any event. I started to seperate the 1 gram pile into 4 equal piles, 1 of which i loaded into an empty pill capsule. I poked a hole in the Shell and swallowed it w/ water Here's a timeline of my trip.
T-:00 Ate the pill. Hope it's worth it
T-:20 Feel kinda warm inside but I had a great day today and I play it off like it's nothing
T-:25 Ok I defiantly feel alot better now but I still don't believe this stuff can kick in that quick
T-:45 OH YEAH!  Now I feel that ever increasing and oh so familiar come up that I had nearly forgotten about.  Hahaha! This is great!
T-01:00 WOW! Now I'm completely emerged in the best feeling I've had since those days of X. How can something perfectly legal get me perfectly f*#ked up like I am. For a minute, I get a little freaked out at the possibility that I somehow got ahold of the 'real $hit'. Man I feel amazing!
T-01:05 After convincing my self that there's no way I could get something like MDMA off the site I used to purchase the stuff. I quickly took another 50mg (or so) bump.
T-01:30    Now I'm f#*ked up!  Hahaha!  I'm completely loaded!  I have somewhat controlled eye wiggles, jaw clenching and some serious dry mouth. I can't stop licking my lips this is nuts! I'm having the time of my life just listening to tiesto and relaxing. I keep getting the urge to smoke but I have no cigarettes. Damn.
T-02:30    Finally got my cig and I'm still goin pretty good but most of the eye wiggles are gone. Jaw clenching and lip licking is still very pronounced. I still feel really good.
T-03:00 I'm defiantly coming down now. Feels like a coke comedown with only a minor itch for more.  Still feel good ironically enough.
T-03:30 The wife comes home and I ask her to try the drug here at home before we go out Saturday. She hesitates but eventually gives in (after like an hour!). My persuasion may have been fueled by a slight urge to redose. I told myself I would save the rest for the weekend but I was a bit curious to see if I could get a similar effect as with X redose.
T-04:30 Redose with wife. She takes about 150mg and I took another 250mg. I also ate the small amount left over from filling the capsules ( about 10-20 mg. )
T-04:20 (hahaha!)    Once again I start to flow into liquid paradise while the wife  anxiously waited to feel the way I did. Our conversation started to grow as I started to peak again. I kept telling her,'your about to feel better than ever!' she has also experimented with X but only a few times and they were sh!tty.
T-05:15 Wife becomes very nauseous and starts to vomit, even while vomiting she feels the rush is quiet pleasurable which makes me feel better about talking her into taking it. This reminds me of times when my friends would vomit from X and they would feel even better than before. I only felt like I needed to puke for a min or so on the methylone. I blame an empty stomach for the nausea. I should have planned for her better. I also took on nearly empty stomach.
T-06:15 Wife finally stops vomiting but the nausea remains. I, on the other hand, have lost most of the euphoric rushes but I'm still very speedy.
T-07:00 Still speedy but mild enough to say it's over. Time for another cigarette that I bummed from my neighbor.
After my first experience, I feel that I will defiantly be ordering more but probably a few more grams so I don't have to order it all the time. I also plan on introducing my friends back home to try it, I'm that impressed with it!  Great overall feeling start to finish. Very euphoric for a couple hours.
